30897// Binding ctx for component hooks.
30898struct component_binding_ctx {
30899 void *on_add = nullptr;
30900 void *on_remove = nullptr;
30901 void *on_set = nullptr;
30902 void *on_replace = nullptr;
30903 ecs_ctx_free_t free_on_add = nullptr;
30904 ecs_ctx_free_t free_on_remove = nullptr;
30905 ecs_ctx_free_t free_on_set = nullptr;
30906 ecs_ctx_free_t free_on_replace = nullptr;
30907
30908 ~component_binding_ctx() {
30909 if (on_add && free_on_add) {
30910 free_on_add(on_add);
30911 }
30912 if (on_remove && free_on_remove) {
30913 free_on_remove(on_remove);
30914 }
30915 if (on_set && free_on_set) {
30916 free_on_set(on_set);
30917 }
30918 if (on_replace && free_on_replace) {
30919 free_on_replace(on_replace);
30920 }
30921 }
30922};
30923
30924// Utility to convert a template argument pack to an array of term pointers.
30925struct field_ptr {
30926 void *ptr = nullptr;
30927 int8_t index = 0;
30928 bool is_ref = false;
30929 bool is_row = false;
30930};
30931
30932template <typename ... Components>
30933struct field_ptrs {
30934 using array = flecs::array<_::field_ptr, sizeof...(Components)>;
30935
30936 void populate(const ecs_iter_t *iter) {
30937 populate_impl(iter, std::index_sequence_for<Components...>{});
30938 }
30939
30940 void populate_self(const ecs_iter_t *iter) {
30941 populate_self_impl(iter, std::index_sequence_for<Components...>{});
30942 }
30943
30944 array fields_;
30945
30946private:
30947 template <typename T>
30948 void populate_field(const ecs_iter_t *iter, size_t index) {
30949 using A = remove_pointer_t<actual_type_t<T>>;
30950 if constexpr (!is_empty_v<A>) {
30951 if (iter->row_fields & (1llu << index)) {
30952 /* Need to fetch the value with ecs_field_at() */
30953 fields_[index].is_row = true;
30954 fields_[index].is_ref = true;
30955 fields_[index].index = static_cast<int8_t>(index);
30956 } else {
30957 fields_[index].ptr = ecs_field_w_size(iter, sizeof(A),
30958 static_cast<int8_t>(index));
30959 fields_[index].is_ref = iter->sources[index] != 0;
30960 }
30961 }
30962 }
30963
30964 template <typename T>
30965 void populate_self_field(const ecs_iter_t *iter, size_t index) {
30966 (void)iter; (void)index;
30967
30968 using A = remove_pointer_t<actual_type_t<T>>;
30969 if constexpr (!is_empty_v<A>) {
30970 fields_[index].ptr = ecs_field_w_size(iter, sizeof(A),
30971 static_cast<int8_t>(index));
30972 fields_[index].is_ref = false;
30973 }
30974 }
30975
30976 template <size_t... Is>
30977 void populate_impl(const ecs_iter_t *iter, std::index_sequence<Is...>) {
30978 (void)iter;
30979 (populate_field<Components>(iter, Is), ...);
30980 }
30981
30982 template <size_t... Is>
30983 void populate_self_impl(const ecs_iter_t *iter, std::index_sequence<Is...>) {
30984 (void)iter;
30985 (populate_self_field<Components>(iter, Is), ...);
30986 }
30987};
30988
30989struct delegate { };
30990
30991// Template that figures out from the template parameters of a query/system
30992// how to pass the value to the each callback.
30993template <typename T, typename = int>
30994struct each_field { };
30995
30996// Base class.
30997struct each_column_base {
30998 each_column_base(const _::field_ptr& field, size_t row)
30999 : field_(field), row_(row) {
31000 }
31001
31002protected:
31003 const _::field_ptr& field_;
31004 size_t row_;
31005};
31006
31007// If the type is not a pointer, return a reference to the type (default case).
31008template <typename T>
31009struct each_field<T, if_t< !is_pointer<T>::value &&
31010 !is_empty<actual_type_t<T>>::value && is_actual<T>::value > >
31011 : each_column_base
31012{
31013 each_field(const flecs::iter_t*, _::field_ptr& field, size_t row)
31014 : each_column_base(field, row) { }
31015
31016 T& get_row() {
31017 return static_cast<T*>(this->field_.ptr)[this->row_];
31018 }
31019};
31020
31021// If the argument type is not the same as the actual component type, return by value.
31022// This requires that the actual type can be converted to the type.
31023// A typical scenario where this happens is when using flecs::pair types.
31024template <typename T>
31025struct each_field<T, if_t< !is_pointer<T>::value &&
31026 !is_empty<actual_type_t<T>>::value && !is_actual<T>::value> >
31027 : each_column_base
31028{
31029 each_field(const flecs::iter_t*, _::field_ptr& field, size_t row)
31030 : each_column_base(field, row) { }
31031
31032 T get_row() {
31033 return static_cast<actual_type_t<T>*>(this->field_.ptr)[this->row_];
31034 }
31035};
31036
31037// If the type is empty (indicating a tag), the query will pass a nullptr. To avoid
31038// returning nullptr to reference arguments, return a temporary value.
31039template <typename T>
31040struct each_field<T, if_t< is_empty<actual_type_t<T>>::value &&
31041 !is_pointer<T>::value > >
31042 : each_column_base
31043{
31044 each_field(const flecs::iter_t*, _::field_ptr& field, size_t row)
31045 : each_column_base(field, row) { }
31046
31047 T get_row() {
31048 return actual_type_t<T>();
31049 }
31050};
31051
31052// If the type is a pointer (indicating an optional value), don't index with row if
31053// the field is not set.
31054template <typename T>
31055struct each_field<T, if_t< is_pointer<T>::value &&
31056 !is_empty<actual_type_t<T>>::value > >
31057 : each_column_base
31058{
31059 each_field(const flecs::iter_t*, _::field_ptr& field, size_t row)
31060 : each_column_base(field, row) { }
31061
31062 actual_type_t<T> get_row() {
31063 if (this->field_.ptr) {
31064 return &static_cast<actual_type_t<T>>(this->field_.ptr)[this->row_];
31065 } else {
31066 // Optional argument doesn't have a value.
31067 return nullptr;
31068 }
31069 }
31070};
31071
31072// If the query contains component references to other entities, check if the
31073// current argument is one.
31074template <typename T, typename = int>
31075struct each_ref_field : public each_field<T> {
31076 using A = remove_pointer_t<actual_type_t<T>>;
31077
31078 each_ref_field(const flecs::iter_t *iter, _::field_ptr& field, size_t row)
31079 : each_field<T>(iter, field, row) {
31080
31081 if (field.is_ref) {
31082 // If this is a reference, set the row to 0 as a ref is always a
31083 // single value, not an array. This prevents the application from
31084 // having to do an if-check on whether the field is owned.
31085 //
31086 // This check only happens when the current table being iterated
31087 // over caused the query to match a reference. The check is
31088 // performed once per iterated table.
31089 this->row_ = 0;
31090 }
31091
31092 if (field.is_row) {
31093 field.ptr = ecs_field_at_w_size(iter, sizeof(A), field.index,
31094 static_cast<int32_t>(row));
31095 }
31096 }
31097};
31098
31099// Type that handles passing components to each callbacks.
31100template <typename Func, typename ... Components>
31101struct each_delegate : public delegate {
31102 using Terms = typename field_ptrs<Components ...>::array;
31103
31104 template < if_not_t< is_same< decay_t<Func>, decay_t<Func>& >::value > = 0>
31105 explicit each_delegate(Func&& func) noexcept
31106 : func_(FLECS_MOV(func)) { }
31107
31108 explicit each_delegate(const Func& func) noexcept
31109 : func_(func) { }
31110
31111 // Invoke object directly. This operation is useful when the calling
31112 // function has just constructed the delegate, such as what happens when
31113 // iterating a query.
31114 void invoke(ecs_iter_t *iter) const {
31115 field_ptrs<Components...> terms;
31116
31117 iter->flags |= EcsIterCppEach;
31118
31119 if (iter->ref_fields | iter->up_fields) {
31120 terms.populate(iter);
31121 invoke_unpack< each_ref_field >(iter, func_, 0, terms.fields_);
31122 } else {
31123 terms.populate_self(iter);
31124 invoke_unpack< each_field >(iter, func_, 0, terms.fields_);
31125 }
31126 }
31127
31128 // Static function that can be used as callback for systems/observers.
31129 static void run(ecs_iter_t *iter) {
31130 auto self = static_cast<const each_delegate*>(iter->callback_ctx);
31131 ecs_assert(self != nullptr, ECS_INTERNAL_ERROR, NULL);
31132 self->invoke(iter);
31133 }
31134
31135 // Static function that can be used as callback for systems/observers.
31136 // Different from run() in that it loops the iterator.
31137 static void run_each(ecs_iter_t *iter) {
31138 auto self = static_cast<const each_delegate*>(iter->run_ctx);
31139 ecs_assert(self != nullptr, ECS_INTERNAL_ERROR, NULL);
31140 while (iter->next(iter)) {
31141 self->invoke(iter);
31142 }
31143 }
31144
31145 // Create instance of delegate.
31146 static each_delegate* make(const Func& func) {
31147 return FLECS_NEW(each_delegate)(func);
31148 }
31149
31150 // Function that can be used as callback to free delegate.
31151 static void destruct(void *obj) {
31152 _::free_obj<each_delegate>(obj);
31153 }
31154
31155 // Static function to call for component on_add hook.
31156 static void run_add(ecs_iter_t *iter) {
31157 component_binding_ctx *ctx = reinterpret_cast<component_binding_ctx*>(
31158 iter->callback_ctx);
31159 iter->callback_ctx = ctx->on_add;
31160 run(iter);
31161 }
31162
31163 // Static function to call for component on_remove hook.
31164 static void run_remove(ecs_iter_t *iter) {
31165 component_binding_ctx *ctx = reinterpret_cast<component_binding_ctx*>(
31166 iter->callback_ctx);
31167 iter->callback_ctx = ctx->on_remove;
31168 run(iter);
31169 }
31170
31171 // Static function to call for component on_set hook.
31172 static void run_set(ecs_iter_t *iter) {
31173 component_binding_ctx *ctx = reinterpret_cast<component_binding_ctx*>(
31174 iter->callback_ctx);
31175 iter->callback_ctx = ctx->on_set;
31176 run(iter);
31177 }
31178
31179 // Static function to call for component on_replace hook.
31180 static void run_replace(ecs_iter_t *iter) {
31181 component_binding_ctx *ctx = reinterpret_cast<component_binding_ctx*>(
31182 iter->callback_ctx);
31183 iter->callback_ctx = ctx->on_replace;
31184 run(iter);
31185 }
31186
31187private:
31188 // func(flecs::entity, Components...)
31189 template <template<typename X, typename = int> class ColumnType,
31190 typename... Args,
31191 typename Fn = Func,
31192 decltype(std::declval<const Fn&>()(
31193 std::declval<flecs::entity>(),
31194 std::declval<ColumnType< remove_reference_t<Components> > >().get_row()...), 0) = 0>
31195 static void invoke_callback(
31196 ecs_iter_t *iter, const Func& func, size_t i, Args... comps)
31197 {
31198 ecs_assert(iter->entities != nullptr, ECS_INVALID_PARAMETER,
31199 "query does not return entities ($this variable is not populated)");
31200 func(flecs::entity(iter->world, iter->entities[i]),
31201 (ColumnType< remove_reference_t<Components> >(iter, comps, i)
31202 .get_row())...);
31203 }
31204
31205 // func(flecs::iter&, size_t row, Components...)
31206 template <template<typename X, typename = int> class ColumnType,
31207 typename... Args,
31208 typename Fn = Func,
31209 decltype(std::declval<const Fn&>()(
31210 std::declval<flecs::iter&>(),
31211 std::declval<size_t&>(),
31212 std::declval<ColumnType< remove_reference_t<Components> > >().get_row()...), 0) = 0>
31213 static void invoke_callback(
31214 ecs_iter_t *iter, const Func& func, size_t i, Args... comps)
31215 {
31216 flecs::iter it(iter);
31217 func(it, i, (ColumnType< remove_reference_t<Components> >(iter, comps, i)
31218 .get_row())...);
31219 }
31220
31221 // func(Components...)
31222 template <template<typename X, typename = int> class ColumnType,
31223 typename... Args,
31224 typename Fn = Func,
31225 decltype(std::declval<const Fn&>()(
31226 std::declval<ColumnType< remove_reference_t<Components> > >().get_row()...), 0) = 0>
31227 static void invoke_callback(
31228 ecs_iter_t *iter, const Func& func, size_t i, Args... comps)
31229 {
31230 func((ColumnType< remove_reference_t<Components> >(iter, comps, i)
31231 .get_row())...);
31232 }
31233
31234 template <template<typename X, typename = int> class ColumnType,
31235 typename... Args, if_t<
31236 sizeof...(Components) == sizeof...(Args)> = 0>
31237 static void invoke_unpack(
31238 ecs_iter_t *iter, const Func& func, size_t, Terms&, Args... comps)
31239 {
31240 ECS_TABLE_LOCK(iter->world, iter->table);
31241
31242 size_t count = static_cast<size_t>(iter->count);
31243 if (count == 0 && !iter->table) {
31244 // If the query has no This terms, count can be 0. Since each does not
31245 // have an entity parameter, just pass through components.
31246 count = 1;
31247 }
31248
31249 for (size_t i = 0; i < count; i ++) {
31250 invoke_callback<ColumnType>(iter, func, i, comps...);
31251 }
31252
31253 ECS_TABLE_UNLOCK(iter->world, iter->table);
31254 }
31255
31256 template <template<typename X, typename = int> class ColumnType,
31257 typename... Args, if_t< sizeof...(Components) != sizeof...(Args) > = 0>
31258 static void invoke_unpack(ecs_iter_t *iter, const Func& func,
31259 size_t index, Terms& columns, Args... comps)
31260 {
31261 invoke_unpack<ColumnType>(
31262 iter, func, index + 1, columns, comps..., columns[index]);
31263 }
31264
31265public:
31266 Func func_;
31267};

31269template <typename Func, typename ... Components>
31270struct find_delegate : public delegate {
31271 using Terms = typename field_ptrs<Components ...>::array;
31272
31273 template < if_not_t< is_same< decay_t<Func>, decay_t<Func>& >::value > = 0>
31274 explicit find_delegate(Func&& func) noexcept
31275 : func_(FLECS_MOV(func)) { }
31276
31277 explicit find_delegate(const Func& func) noexcept
31278 : func_(func) { }
31279
31280 // Invoke object directly. This operation is useful when the calling
31281 // function has just constructed the delegate, such as what happens when
31282 // iterating a query.
31283 flecs::entity invoke(ecs_iter_t *iter) const {
31284 field_ptrs<Components...> terms;
31285
31286 iter->flags |= EcsIterCppEach;
31287
31288 if (iter->ref_fields | iter->up_fields) {
31289 terms.populate(iter);
31290 return invoke_callback< each_ref_field >(iter, func_, 0, terms.fields_);
31291 } else {
31292 terms.populate_self(iter);
31293 return invoke_callback< each_field >(iter, func_, 0, terms.fields_);
31294 }
31295 }
31296
31297private:
31298 // The number of function arguments is one more than the number of components, pass
31299 // entity as argument.
31300 template <template<typename X, typename = int> class ColumnType,
31301 typename... Args,
31302 typename Fn = Func,
31303 if_t<sizeof...(Components) == sizeof...(Args)> = 0,
31304 decltype(bool(std::declval<const Fn&>()(
31305 std::declval<flecs::entity>(),
31306 std::declval<ColumnType< remove_reference_t<Components> > >().get_row()...))) = true>
31307 static flecs::entity invoke_callback(
31308 ecs_iter_t *iter, const Func& func, size_t, Terms&, Args... comps)
31309 {
31310 ECS_TABLE_LOCK(iter->world, iter->table);
31311
31312 ecs_world_t *world = iter->world;
31313 size_t count = static_cast<size_t>(iter->count);
31314 flecs::entity result;
31315
31316 for (size_t i = 0; i < count; i ++) {
31317 if (func(flecs::entity(world, iter->entities[i]),
31318 (ColumnType< remove_reference_t<Components> >(iter, comps, i)
31319 .get_row())...))
31320 {
31321 result = flecs::entity(world, iter->entities[i]);
31322 break;
31323 }
31324 }
31325
31326 ECS_TABLE_UNLOCK(iter->world, iter->table);
31327
31328 return result;
31329 }
31330
31331 // The number of function arguments is two more than the number of components, pass
31332 // iter + index as argument.
31333 template <template<typename X, typename = int> class ColumnType,
31334 typename... Args,
31335 typename Fn = Func,
31336 if_t<sizeof...(Components) == sizeof...(Args)> = 0,
31337 decltype(bool(std::declval<const Fn&>()(
31338 std::declval<flecs::iter&>(),
31339 std::declval<size_t&>(),
31340 std::declval<ColumnType< remove_reference_t<Components> > >().get_row()...))) = true>
31341 static flecs::entity invoke_callback(
31342 ecs_iter_t *iter, const Func& func, size_t, Terms&, Args... comps)
31343 {
31344 size_t count = static_cast<size_t>(iter->count);
31345 if (count == 0) {
31346 // If the query has no This terms, count can be 0. Since each does not
31347 // have an entity parameter, just pass through components.
31348 count = 1;
31349 }
31350
31351 flecs::iter it(iter);
31352 flecs::entity result;
31353
31354 ECS_TABLE_LOCK(iter->world, iter->table);
31355
31356 for (size_t i = 0; i < count; i ++) {
31357 if (func(it, i,
31358 (ColumnType< remove_reference_t<Components> >(iter, comps, i)
31359 .get_row())...))
31360 {
31361 result = flecs::entity(iter->world, iter->entities[i]);
31362 break;
31363 }
31364 }
31365
31366 ECS_TABLE_UNLOCK(iter->world, iter->table);
31367
31368 return result;
31369 }
31370
31371 // The number of function arguments is equal to the number of components, no entity.
31372 template <template<typename X, typename = int> class ColumnType,
31373 typename... Args,
31374 typename Fn = Func,
31375 if_t<sizeof...(Components) == sizeof...(Args)> = 0,
31376 decltype(bool(std::declval<const Fn&>()(
31377 std::declval<ColumnType< remove_reference_t<Components> > >().get_row()...))) = true>
31378 static flecs::entity invoke_callback(
31379 ecs_iter_t *iter, const Func& func, size_t, Terms&, Args... comps)
31380 {
31381 size_t count = static_cast<size_t>(iter->count);
31382 if (count == 0) {
31383 // If the query has no This terms, count can be 0. Since each does not
31384 // have an entity parameter, just pass through components.
31385 count = 1;
31386 }
31387
31388 flecs::iter it(iter);
31389 flecs::entity result;
31390
31391 ECS_TABLE_LOCK(iter->world, iter->table);
31392
31393 for (size_t i = 0; i < count; i ++) {
31394 if (func(
31395 (ColumnType< remove_reference_t<Components> >(iter, comps, i)
31396 .get_row())...))
31397 {
31398 result = flecs::entity(iter->world, iter->entities[i]);
31399 break;
31400 }
31401 }
31402
31403 ECS_TABLE_UNLOCK(iter->world, iter->table);
31404
31405 return result;
31406 }
31407
31408 template <template<typename X, typename = int> class ColumnType,
31409 typename... Args, if_t< sizeof...(Components) != sizeof...(Args) > = 0>
31410 static flecs::entity invoke_callback(ecs_iter_t *iter, const Func& func,
31411 size_t index, Terms& columns, Args... comps)
31412 {
31413 return invoke_callback<ColumnType>(
31414 iter, func, index + 1, columns, comps..., columns[index]);
31415 }
31416
31417 Func func_;
31418};

31533template<typename ... Args>
31534struct entity_with_delegate_impl;
31535
31536template<typename ... Args>
31537struct entity_with_delegate_impl<arg_list<Args ...>> {
31538 using ColumnArray = flecs::array<int32_t, sizeof...(Args)>;
31539 using ArrayType = flecs::array<void*, sizeof...(Args)>;
31540 using DummyArray = flecs::array<int, sizeof...(Args)>;
31541 using IdArray = flecs::array<id_t, sizeof...(Args)>;
31542
31543 static constexpr bool const_args() {
31544 return (is_const_v<remove_reference_t<Args>> && ...);
31545 }
31546
31547 static
31548 bool get_ptrs(world_t *world, flecs::entity_t e, const ecs_record_t *r, ecs_table_t *table,
31549 ArrayType& ptrs)
31550 {
31551 ecs_assert(table != NULL, ECS_INTERNAL_ERROR, NULL);
31552
31553 /* table_index_of needs the real world. */
31554 const flecs::world_t *real_world = ecs_get_world(world);
31555
31556 IdArray ids ({
31557 _::type<Args>().id(world)...
31558 });
31559
31560 /* Get column indices for components. */
31561 ColumnArray columns ({
31562 ecs_table_get_column_index(real_world, table,
31563 _::type<Args>().id(world))...
31564 });
31565
31566 /* Get pointers for columns for the entity. */
31567 size_t i = 0;
31568 for (int32_t column : columns) {
31569 if (column == -1) {
31570 /* Component could be sparse. */
31571 void *ptr = ecs_get_mut_id(world, e, ids[i]);
31572 if (!ptr) {
31573 return false;
31574 }
31575
31576 ptrs[i ++] = ptr;
31577 continue;
31578 }
31579
31580 ptrs[i ++] = ecs_record_get_by_column(r, column, 0);
31581 }
31582
31583 return true;
31584 }
31585
31586 static bool ensure_ptrs(world_t *world, ecs_entity_t e, ArrayType& ptrs) {
31587 /* Get pointers w/ensure. */
31588 size_t i = 0;
31589 DummyArray dummy ({
31590 (ptrs[i ++] = ecs_ensure_id(world, e,
31591 _::type<Args>().id(world), sizeof(Args)), 0)...
31592 });
31593
31594 return true;
31595 }
31596
31597 template <typename Func>
31598 static bool invoke_read(world_t *world, entity_t e, const Func& func) {
31599 const ecs_record_t *r = ecs_read_begin(world, e);
31600 if (!r) {
31601 return false;
31602 }
31603
31604 ecs_table_t *table = r->table;
31605 if (!table) {
31606 return false;
31607 }
31608
31609 ArrayType ptrs;
31610 bool has_components = get_ptrs(world, e, r, table, ptrs);
31611 if (has_components) {
31612 invoke_callback(func, 0, ptrs);
31613 }
31614
31615 ecs_read_end(r);
31616
31617 return has_components;
31618 }
31619
31620 template <typename Func>
31621 static bool invoke_write(world_t *world, entity_t e, const Func& func) {
31622 ecs_record_t *r = ecs_write_begin(world, e);
31623 if (!r) {
31624 return false;
31625 }
31626
31627 ecs_table_t *table = r->table;
31628 if (!table) {
31629 return false;
31630 }
31631
31632 ArrayType ptrs;
31633 bool has_components = get_ptrs(world, e, r, table, ptrs);
31634 if (has_components) {
31635 invoke_callback(func, 0, ptrs);
31636 }
31637
31638 ecs_write_end(r);
31639
31640 return has_components;
31641 }
31642
31643 template <typename Func>
31644 static bool invoke_get(world_t *world, entity_t e, const Func& func) {
31645 if constexpr (const_args()) {
31646 return invoke_read(world, e, func);
31647 } else {
31648 return invoke_write(world, e, func);
31649 }
31650 }
31651
31652 // Utility for storing an ID in an array in pack expansion.
31653 static size_t store_added(IdArray& added, size_t elem, ecs_table_t *prev,
31654 ecs_table_t *next, id_t id)
31655 {
31656 // Array should only contain IDs for components that are actually added,
31657 // so check if the prev and next tables are different.
31658 if (prev != next) {
31659 added[elem] = id;
31660 elem ++;
31661 }
31662 return elem;
31663 }
31664
31665 struct InvokeCtx {
31666 InvokeCtx(flecs::table_t *table_arg) : table(table_arg) { }
31667 flecs::table_t *table;
31668 size_t component_count = 0;
31669 IdArray added = {};
31670 };
31671
31672 static int invoke_add(
31673 flecs::world& w,
31674 flecs::entity_t entity,
31675 flecs::id_t component_id,
31676 InvokeCtx& ctx)
31677 {
31678 ecs_table_diff_t diff;
31679 flecs::table_t *next = flecs_table_traverse_add(
31680 w, ctx.table, &component_id, &diff);
31681 if (next != ctx.table) {
31682 ctx.added[ctx.component_count] = component_id;
31683 ctx.component_count ++;
31684 } else {
31685 if (diff.added_flags & EcsTableHasDontFragment) {
31686 w.entity(entity).add(component_id);
31687
31688 ctx.added[ctx.component_count] = component_id;
31689 ctx.component_count ++;
31690 }
31691 }
31692
31693 ctx.table = next;
31694
31695 return 0;
31696 }
31697
31698 template <typename Func>
31699 static bool invoke_ensure(
31700 world_t *world,
31701 entity_t id,
31702 const Func& func)
31703 {
31704 flecs::world w(world);
31705
31706 ArrayType ptrs;
31707 ecs_table_t *table = NULL;
31708
31709 // When not deferred, take the fast path.
31710 if (!w.is_deferred()) {
31711 // A bit of low-level code so we only do at most one table move and one
31712 // entity lookup for the entire operation.
31713
31714 // Make sure the object is not a stage. Operations on a stage are
31715 // only allowed when the stage is in deferred mode, which is when
31716 // the world is in readonly mode.
31717 ecs_assert(!w.is_stage(), ECS_INVALID_PARAMETER, NULL);
31718
31719 // Find the table for the entity.
31720 ecs_record_t *r = ecs_record_find(world, id);
31721 if (r) {
31722 table = r->table;
31723 }
31724
31725 // Iterate components, only store added component IDs in the added array.
31726 InvokeCtx ctx(table);
31727 DummyArray dummy_before ({ (
31728 invoke_add(w, id, w.id<Args>(), ctx)
31729 )... });
31730
31731 (void)dummy_before;
31732
31733 // If the table is different, move the entity straight to it.
31734 if (table != ctx.table) {
31735 ecs_type_t ids;
31736 ids.array = ctx.added.ptr();
31737 ids.count = static_cast<ecs_size_t>(ctx.component_count);
31738 ecs_commit(world, id, r, ctx.table, &ids, NULL);
31739 table = ctx.table;
31740 }
31741
31742 if (!get_ptrs(w, id, r, table, ptrs)) {
31743 ecs_abort(ECS_INTERNAL_ERROR, NULL);
31744 }
31745
31746 ECS_TABLE_LOCK(world, table);
31747
31748 // When deferred, obtain pointers with regular ensure.
31749 } else {
31750 ensure_ptrs(world, id, ptrs);
31751 }
31752
31753 invoke_callback(func, 0, ptrs);
31754
31755 if (!w.is_deferred()) {
31756 ECS_TABLE_UNLOCK(world, table);
31757 }
31758
31759 // Call modified on each component.
31760 DummyArray dummy_after ({
31761 ( ecs_modified_id(world, id, w.id<Args>()), 0)...
31762 });
31763 (void)dummy_after;
31764
31765 return true;
31766 }
31767
31768private:
31769 template <typename Func, typename ... TArgs,
31770 if_t<sizeof...(TArgs) == sizeof...(Args)> = 0>
31771 static void invoke_callback(
31772 const Func& f, size_t, ArrayType&, TArgs&& ... comps)
31773 {
31774 f(*static_cast<typename base_arg_type<Args>::type*>(comps)...);
31775 }
31776
31777 template <typename Func, typename ... TArgs,
31778 if_t<sizeof...(TArgs) != sizeof...(Args)> = 0>
31779 static void invoke_callback(const Func& f, size_t arg, ArrayType& ptrs,
31780 TArgs&& ... comps)
31781 {
31782 invoke_callback(f, arg + 1, ptrs, comps..., ptrs[arg]);
31783 }
31784};

31890// If the type is trivial, don't register lifecycle actions. While the functions
31891// that obtain the lifecycle callback do detect whether the callback is required,
31892// adding a special case for trivial types eases the burden a bit on the
31893// compiler, as it reduces the number of templates to evaluate.
31894template<typename T>
31895void register_lifecycle_actions(
31896 ecs_world_t *world,
31897 ecs_entity_t component)
31898{
31899 (void)world; (void)component;
31900 if constexpr (!std::is_trivial<T>::value) {
31901 // If the component is non-trivial, register component lifecycle actions.
31902 // Depending on the type, not all callbacks may be available.
31903 ecs_type_hooks_t cl{};
31904 cl.ctor = ctor<T>(cl.flags);
31905 cl.dtor = dtor<T>(cl.flags);
31906
31907 cl.copy = copy<T>(cl.flags);
31908 cl.copy_ctor = copy_ctor<T>(cl.flags);
31909 cl.move = move<T>(cl.flags);
31910 cl.move_ctor = move_ctor<T>(cl.flags);
31911
31912 cl.ctor_move_dtor = ctor_move_dtor<T>(cl.flags);
31913 cl.move_dtor = move_dtor<T>(cl.flags);
31914
31915 cl.flags &= ECS_TYPE_HOOKS_ILLEGAL;
31916 ecs_set_hooks_id(world, component, &cl);
31917
31918 if (cl.flags & (ECS_TYPE_HOOK_MOVE_ILLEGAL|ECS_TYPE_HOOK_MOVE_CTOR_ILLEGAL))
31919 {
31920 ecs_add_id(world, component, flecs::Sparse);
31921 }
31922 }
31923}
31924
31925template <typename T>
31926inline ecs_cpp_type_action_t lifecycle_action() {
31927 if constexpr (std::is_trivial<T>::value) {
31928 return nullptr;
31929 } else {
31930 return &register_lifecycle_actions<T>;
31931 }
31932}

31947 if constexpr (has_cpp_meta_desc<T>::value) {

31962
31963template <typename T>
31964inline void register_cpp_meta(ecs_world_t *world, ecs_entity_t component) {
31965 (void)world; (void)component;
31966 if constexpr (has_cpp_meta_desc<T>::value) {
31967 ecs_type_kind_t kind = flecs_meta_cpp_kind(static_cast<T*>(nullptr));
31968 if (kind == EcsStructType && ecs_has_id(world, component,
31969 ecs_id(EcsStruct))) {
31970 return;
31971 }
31972 if (kind == EcsEnumType && ecs_has_id(world, component,
31973 ecs_id(EcsEnum))) {
31974 return;
31975 }
31976 if (kind == EcsBitmaskType && ecs_has_id(world, component,
31977 ecs_id(EcsBitmask))) {
31978 return;
31979 }
31980 ecs_meta_from_desc(world, component, kind,
31981 flecs_meta_cpp_desc(static_cast<T*>(nullptr)));
31982 }
31983}
31984#endif

31986template <typename T>
31987struct type_impl {
31988 static_assert(is_pointer<T>::value == false,
31989 "pointer types are not allowed for components");
31990
31991 // Initialize the component identifier.
31992 static void init(
31993 bool allow_tag = true)
31994 {
31995 index(); // Make sure the global component index is initialized.
31996
31997 s_size = sizeof(T);
31998 s_alignment = alignof(T);
31999 if (is_empty<T>::value && allow_tag) {
32000 s_size = 0;
32001 s_alignment = 0;
32002 }
32003 }
32004
32005 static void init_builtin(
32006 flecs::world_t *world,
32007 flecs::entity_t id,
32008 bool allow_tag = true)
32009 {
32010 init(allow_tag);
32011 flecs_component_ids_set(world, index(), id);
32012 }
32013
32014 // Register the component ID.
32015 static entity_t register_id(
32016 world_t *world, // The world
32017 const char *name = nullptr, // User-provided name (overrides typename)
32018 bool allow_tag = true, // Register empty types as zero-sized components
32019 bool is_component = true, // Add flecs::Component to the result
32020 bool explicit_registration = false, // Entered from world.component<T>()?
32021 flecs::id_t id = 0) // User-provided component ID
32022 {
32023 init(allow_tag);
32024 ecs_assert(index() != 0, ECS_INTERNAL_ERROR, NULL);
32025
32026 ecs_cpp_component_desc_t desc = {
32027 id,
32028 index(),
32029 name,
32030 type_name<T>(),
32031 component_symbol_name<T>(),
32032 size(),
32033 alignment(),
32034 lifecycle_action<T>(),
32035 enum_action<T>(),
32036 is_component,
32037 explicit_registration
32038 };
32039
32040 flecs::entity_t c = ecs_cpp_component_register(world, &desc);
32041
32042 ecs_assert(c != 0, ECS_INTERNAL_ERROR, NULL);
32043
32044#ifdef FLECS_META
32045 register_cpp_meta<T>(world, c);
32046#endif
32047
32048 return c;
32049 }
32050
32051 // Get the type (component) ID.
32052 // If the type was not yet registered and automatic registration is allowed,
32053 // this function will also register the type.
32054 static entity_t id(world_t *world)
32055 {
32056#ifdef FLECS_CPP_NO_AUTO_REGISTRATION
32057 ecs_assert(registered(world), ECS_INVALID_OPERATION,
32058 "component '%s' must be registered before use",
32059 type_name<T>());
32060
32061 flecs::entity_t c = flecs_component_ids_get(world, index());
32062 ecs_assert(c != 0, ECS_INTERNAL_ERROR, NULL);
32063 ecs_assert(ecs_is_alive(world, c), ECS_INVALID_OPERATION,
32064 "component '%s' was deleted, reregister before using",
32065 type_name<T>());
32066#else
32067 flecs::entity_t c = flecs_component_ids_get_alive(world, index());
32068 if (!c) {
32069 c = register_id(world);
32070 }
32071#endif
32072 return c;
32073 }
32074
32075 // Return the size of a component.
32076 static size_t size() {
32077 return s_size;
32078 }
32079
32080 // Return the alignment of a component.
32081 static size_t alignment() {
32082 return s_alignment;
32083 }
32084
32085 // Was the component already registered?
32086 static bool registered(flecs::world_t *world) {
32087 ecs_assert(world != nullptr, ECS_INVALID_PARAMETER, NULL);
32088
32089 if (!flecs_component_ids_get(world, index())) {
32090 return false;
32091 }
32092
32093 return true;
32094 }
32095
32096 // This function is only used to test cross-translation-unit features. No
32097 // code other than test cases should invoke this function.
32098 static void reset() {
32099 s_size = 0;
32100 s_alignment = 0;
32101 }
32102
32103 static int32_t index() {
32104 static int32_t index_ = flecs_component_ids_index_get();
32105 return index_;
32106 }
32107
32108 static size_t s_size;
32109 static size_t s_alignment;
32110};

32112// Global templated variables that hold the component identifier and other info.
32113template <typename T> inline size_t type_impl<T>::s_size;
32114template <typename T> inline size_t type_impl<T>::s_alignment;

32119// Regular type.
32120template <typename T>
32121struct type<T, if_not_t< is_pair<T>::value >>
32122 : type_impl<base_type_t<T>> { };

32127{

32129 static id_t id(world_t *world = nullptr) {
32130 return ecs_pair(
32131 type< pair_first_t<T> >::id(world),
32132 type< pair_second_t<T> >::id(world));
32133 }

32198protected:
32199
32204 flecs::type_hooks_t get_hooks() const {
32205 const flecs::type_hooks_t* h = ecs_get_hooks_id(world_, id_);
32206 if (h) {
32207 return *h;
32208 } else {
32209 return {};
32210 }

32212
32217 void set_hooks(flecs::type_hooks_t &h) {
32218 h.flags &= ECS_TYPE_HOOKS_ILLEGAL;

32222public:
32223
32229untyped_component& on_compare(
32230 ecs_cmp_t compare_callback)
32231{
32232 ecs_assert(compare_callback, ECS_INVALID_PARAMETER, NULL);
32233 flecs::type_hooks_t h = get_hooks();
32234 h.cmp = compare_callback;
32235 h.flags &= ~ECS_TYPE_HOOK_CMP_ILLEGAL;
32236 if(h.flags & ECS_TYPE_HOOK_EQUALS_ILLEGAL) {
32237 h.flags &= ~ECS_TYPE_HOOK_EQUALS_ILLEGAL;
32238 h.equals = NULL;
32239 }
32240 set_hooks(h);
32241 return *this;
32242}
32243
32249untyped_component& on_equals(
32250 ecs_equals_t equals_callback)
32251{
32252 ecs_assert(equals_callback, ECS_INVALID_PARAMETER, NULL);
32253 flecs::type_hooks_t h = get_hooks();
32254 h.equals = equals_callback;
32255 h.flags &= ~ECS_TYPE_HOOK_EQUALS_ILLEGAL;
32256 set_hooks(h);
32257 return *this;
32258}

32496untyped_component& range(

32506 m->range.max = max;
32507
32508 if (m->member) {
32509 flecs::world w(world_);
32510 flecs::entity me = w.entity(m->member);
32511 flecs::MemberRanges *mr = static_cast<flecs::MemberRanges*>(
32512 ecs_ensure_id(w, me, w.id<flecs::MemberRanges>(),
32513 sizeof(flecs::MemberRanges)));
32514 mr->value.min = min;
32515 mr->value.max = max;
32516 me.modified<flecs::MemberRanges>();
32517 }
32518
32519 return *this;
32520}

32644 template <typename Func>
32645 component<T>& on_add(Func&& func) {
32646 using Delegate = typename _::each_delegate<typename std::decay<Func>::type, T>;
32647 flecs::type_hooks_t h = get_hooks();
32648 ecs_assert(h.on_add == nullptr, ECS_INVALID_OPERATION,
32649 "on_add hook is already set");
32650 BindingCtx *ctx = get_binding_ctx(h);
32651 h.on_add = Delegate::run_add;
32652 ctx->on_add = FLECS_NEW(Delegate)(FLECS_FWD(func));
32653 ctx->free_on_add = _::free_obj<Delegate>;
32654 set_hooks(h);
32655 return *this;
32656 }

32668 ecs_assert(h.on_remove == nullptr, ECS_INVALID_OPERATION,
32669 "on_remove hook is already set");

32671 h.on_remove = Delegate::run_remove;

32673 ctx->free_on_remove = _::free_obj<Delegate>;

32804component<T>& constant(const char *name, T value) {
32805 using U = typename std::underlying_type<T>::type;
32806
32807 ecs_add_id(world_, id_, _::type<flecs::Enum>::id(world_));
32808
32809 ecs_entity_desc_t desc = {};
32810 desc.name = name;
32811 desc.parent = id_;
32812 ecs_entity_t eid = ecs_entity_init(world_, &desc);
32813 ecs_assert(eid != 0, ECS_INTERNAL_ERROR, NULL);
32814
32815 flecs::id_t pair = ecs_pair(flecs::Constant, _::type<U>::id(world_));
32816 U *ptr = static_cast<U*>(ecs_ensure_id(world_, eid, pair, sizeof(U)));
32817 *ptr = static_cast<U>(value);
32818 ecs_modified_id(world_, eid, pair);
32819
32820 // If we're not using automatic enum reflection, manually set static data.
32821 #ifdef FLECS_CPP_NO_ENUM_REFLECTION
32822 auto et = enum_type<T>(world_);
32823 et.register_constant(world_, static_cast<U>(value), eid);
32824 #endif
32825
32826 return *this;
32827}

32829# endif

32831private:
32832 using BindingCtx = _::component_binding_ctx;
32833
32834 BindingCtx* get_binding_ctx(flecs::type_hooks_t& h){
32835 BindingCtx *result = static_cast<BindingCtx*>(h.binding_ctx);
32836 if (!result) {
32837 result = FLECS_NEW(BindingCtx);
32838 h.binding_ctx = result;
32839 h.binding_ctx_free = _::free_obj<BindingCtx>;
32840 }
32841 return result;
32842 }

33407 table_range(world_t *world, table_t *t, int32_t offset, int32_t count)
33408 : table(world, t)
33409 , offset_(offset)
33410 , count_(count) { }
33411
33413 int32_t offset() const {
33414 return offset_;
33415 }
33416
33418 int32_t count() const {
33419 return count_;
33420 }
33421
33427 void* get_column(int32_t index) const override {
33428 return ecs_table_get_column(table_, index, offset_);
33429 }
33430
33431private:
33432 int32_t offset_ = 0;
33433 int32_t count_ = 0;
33434};

33443template <typename ... Components>
33444struct iter_iterable;
33445
33447template <typename ... Components>
33448struct page_iterable;
33449
33451template <typename ... Components>
33452struct worker_iterable;
33453
33455template <typename ... Components>
33456struct iterable {
33457
33467 template <typename Func>
33468 void each(Func&& func) const {
33469 ecs_iter_t it = this->get_iter(nullptr);
33470 ecs_iter_next_action_t next = this->next_action();
33471 while (next(&it)) {
33472 _::each_delegate<Func, Components...>(func).invoke(&it);
33473 }
33474 }
33475
33483 template <typename Func>
33484 void run(Func&& func) const {
33485 ecs_iter_t it = this->get_iter(nullptr);
33486 _::run_delegate<Func>(func).invoke(&it);
33487 }
33488
33495 template <typename Func>
33496 flecs::entity find(Func&& func) const {
33497 ecs_iter_t it = this->get_iter(nullptr);
33498 ecs_iter_next_action_t next = this->next_action();
33499
33500 flecs::entity result;
33501 while (!result && next(&it)) {
33502 result = _::find_delegate<Func, Components...>(func).invoke(&it);
33503 }
33504
33505 if (result) {
33506 ecs_iter_fini(&it);
33507 }
33508
33509 return result;
33510 }
33511
33515 iter_iterable<Components...> iter(flecs::world_t *world = nullptr) const;
33516
33520 iter_iterable<Components...> iter(flecs::iter& iter) const;
33521
33525 iter_iterable<Components...> iter(flecs::entity e) const;
33526
33534 page_iterable<Components...> page(int32_t offset, int32_t limit);
33535
33544 worker_iterable<Components...> worker(int32_t index, int32_t count);
33545
33547 int32_t count() const {
33548 return this->iter().count();
33549 }
33550
33552 bool is_true() const {
33553 return this->iter().is_true();
33554 }
33555
33557 flecs::entity first() const {
33558 return this->iter().first();
33559 }
33560
33562 iter_iterable<Components...> set_var(int var_id, flecs::entity_t value) const {
33563 return this->iter().set_var(var_id, value);
33564 }
33565
33567 iter_iterable<Components...> set_var(const char *name, flecs::entity_t value) const {
33568 return this->iter().set_var(name, value);
33569 }
33570
33572 iter_iterable<Components...> set_var(const char *name, flecs::table_t *value) const {
33573 return this->iter().set_var(name, value);
33574 }
33575
33577 iter_iterable<Components...> set_var(const char *name, ecs_table_range_t value) const {
33578 return this->iter().set_var(name, value);
33579 }
33580
33582 iter_iterable<Components...> set_var(const char *name, flecs::table_range value) const {
33583 return this->iter().set_var(name, value);
33584 }
33585
33587 iter_iterable<Components...> set_group(uint64_t group_id) const {
33588 return this->iter().set_group(group_id);
33589 }
33590
33592 template <typename Group>
33593 iter_iterable<Components...> set_group() const {
33594 return this->iter().template set_group<Group>();
33595 }
33596
33598 virtual ~iterable() { }
33599protected:
33600 friend iter_iterable<Components...>;
33601 friend page_iterable<Components...>;
33602 friend worker_iterable<Components...>;
33603
33604 virtual ecs_iter_t get_iter(flecs::world_t *stage) const = 0;
33605 virtual ecs_iter_next_action_t next_action() const = 0;
33606};

33609template <typename ... Components>
33610struct iter_iterable final : iterable<Components...> {
33612 template <typename Iterable>
33613 iter_iterable(Iterable *it, flecs::world_t *world)
33614 {
33615 it_ = it->get_iter(world);
33616 next_ = it->next_action();
33617 next_each_ = it->next_action();
33618 ecs_assert(next_ != nullptr, ECS_INTERNAL_ERROR, NULL);
33619 ecs_assert(next_each_ != nullptr, ECS_INTERNAL_ERROR, NULL);
33620 }
33621
33623 iter_iterable<Components...>& set_var(int var_id, flecs::entity_t value) {
33624 ecs_assert(var_id != -1, ECS_INVALID_PARAMETER, 0);
33625 ecs_iter_set_var(&it_, var_id, value);
33626 return *this;
33627 }
33628
33630 iter_iterable<Components...>& set_var(const char *name, flecs::entity_t value) {
33631 int var_id = ecs_query_find_var(it_.query, name);
33632 ecs_assert(var_id != -1, ECS_INVALID_PARAMETER, "%s", name);
33633 ecs_iter_set_var(&it_, var_id, value);
33634 return *this;
33635 }
33636
33638 iter_iterable<Components...>& set_var(const char *name, flecs::table_t *value) {
33639 int var_id = ecs_query_find_var(it_.query, name);
33640 ecs_assert(var_id != -1, ECS_INVALID_PARAMETER, "%s", name);
33641 ecs_iter_set_var_as_table(&it_, var_id, value);
33642 return *this;
33643 }
33644
33646 iter_iterable<Components...>& set_var(const char *name, ecs_table_range_t value) {
33647 int var_id = ecs_query_find_var(it_.query, name);
33648 ecs_assert(var_id != -1, ECS_INVALID_PARAMETER, "%s", name);
33649 ecs_iter_set_var_as_range(&it_, var_id, &value);
33650 return *this;
33651 }
33652
33654 iter_iterable<Components...>& set_var(const char *name, flecs::table_range value) {
33655 ecs_table_range_t range;
33656 range.table = value.get_table();
33657 range.offset = value.offset();
33658 range.count = value.count();
33659 return set_var(name, range);
33660 }
33661
33662# ifdef FLECS_JSON
33663
33669flecs::string to_json(flecs::iter_to_json_desc_t *desc = nullptr) {
33670 char *json = ecs_iter_to_json(&it_, desc);
33671 return flecs::string(json);
33672}
33673
33674# endif
33675
33677 int32_t count() {
33678 int32_t result = 0;
33679 while (next_each_(&it_)) {
33680 result += it_.count;
33681 }
33682 return result;
33683 }
33684
33686 bool is_true() {
33687 bool result = next_each_(&it_);
33688 if (result) {
33689 ecs_iter_fini(&it_);
33690 }
33691 return result;
33692 }
33693
33695 flecs::entity first() {
33696 flecs::entity result;
33697 if (next_each_(&it_) && it_.count) {
33698 result = flecs::entity(it_.world, it_.entities[0]);
33699 ecs_iter_fini(&it_);
33700 }
33701 return result;
33702 }
33703
33705 iter_iterable<Components...>& set_group(uint64_t group_id) {
33706 ecs_iter_set_group(&it_, group_id);
33707 return *this;
33708 }
33709
33711 template <typename Group>
33712 iter_iterable<Components...>& set_group() {
33713 ecs_iter_set_group(&it_, _::type<Group>().id(it_.real_world));
33714 return *this;
33715 }
33716
33717protected:
33718 ecs_iter_t get_iter(flecs::world_t *world) const override {
33719 if (world) {
33720 ecs_iter_t result = it_;
33721 result.world = world;
33722 return result;
33723 }
33724 return it_;
33725 }
33726
33727 ecs_iter_next_action_t next_action() const override {
33728 return next_;
33729 }
33730
33731private:
33732 ecs_iter_t it_;
33733 ecs_iter_next_action_t next_;
33734 ecs_iter_next_action_t next_each_;
33735};

34037template <typename Func>
34038inline void entity_view::each(const Func& func) const {
34039 const ecs_type_t *type = ecs_get_type(world_, id_);
34040 if (!type) {
34041 return;
34042 }
34043
34044 const ecs_id_t *ids = type->array;
34045 int32_t count = type->count;
34046
34047 for (int i = 0; i < count; i ++) {
34048 ecs_id_t id = ids[i];
34049 flecs::id ent(world_, id);
34050 func(ent);
34051 }
34052}
34053
34054template <typename Func>
34055inline void entity_view::each(flecs::id_t pred, flecs::id_t obj, const Func& func) const {
34056 flecs::world_t *real_world = const_cast<flecs::world_t*>(
34057 ecs_get_world(world_));
34058
34059 const ecs_table_t *table = ecs_get_table(world_, id_);
34060 if (!table) {
34061 return;
34062 }
34063
34064 const ecs_type_t *type = ecs_table_get_type(table);
34065 if (!type) {
34066 return;
34067 }
34068
34069 flecs::id_t pattern = pred;
34070 if (obj) {
34071 pattern = ecs_pair(pred, obj);
34072 }
34073
34074 int32_t cur = 0;
34075 id_t *ids = type->array;
34076
34077 while (-1 != (cur = ecs_search_offset(real_world, table, cur, pattern, 0)))
34078 {
34079 flecs::id ent(world_, ids[cur]);
34080 func(ent);
34081 cur ++;
34082 }
34083}
34084
34085template <typename Func>

34088 flecs::entity obj = id.second();
34089 func(obj);
34090 });

34189 is_const_p<T>::value || is_reference<T>::value > = 0>
34190 constexpr flecs::inout_kind_t type_to_inout() {
34191 return flecs::InOutDefault;
34192 }
34193
34194 template <typename T, if_t< is_pointer<T>::value > = 0>
34195 constexpr flecs::oper_kind_t type_to_oper() {
34196 return flecs::Optional;
34197 }
34198
34199 template <typename T, if_not_t< is_pointer<T>::value > = 0>
34200 constexpr flecs::oper_kind_t type_to_oper() {
34201 return flecs::And;

34204 template <typename ... Components>
34205 struct sig {
34206 sig(flecs::world_t *world)
34207 : world_(world)
34208 , ids({ (_::type<remove_pointer_t<Components>>::id(world))... })
34209 , inout ({ (type_to_inout<Components>())... })
34210 , oper ({ (type_to_oper<Components>())... })
34211 { }
34212
34213 flecs::world_t *world_;
34214 flecs::array<flecs::id_t, sizeof...(Components)> ids;
34215 flecs::array<flecs::inout_kind_t, sizeof...(Components)> inout;
34216 flecs::array<flecs::oper_kind_t, sizeof...(Components)> oper;
34217
34218 template <typename Builder>
34219 void populate(const Builder& b) {
34220 size_t i = 0;
34221 for (auto id : ids) {
34222 b->with(id).inout(inout[i]).oper(oper[i]);
34223 i ++;
34224 }
34225 }
34226 };

34243template<typename Base>
34244struct term_ref_builder_i {
34246 term_ref_builder_i() : term_ref_(nullptr) { }
34247
34249 virtual ~term_ref_builder_i() { }
34250
34252 Base& self() {
34253 this->assert_term_ref();
34254 term_ref_->id |= flecs::Self;
34255 return *this;
34256 }
34257
34259 Base& id(flecs::entity_t id) {
34260 this->assert_term_ref();
34261 term_ref_->id = id;
34262 return *this;
34263 }
34264
34273 Base& entity(flecs::entity_t entity) {
34274 this->assert_term_ref();
34275 term_ref_->id = entity | flecs::IsEntity;
34276 return *this;
34277 }
34278
34280 Base& name(const char *name) {
34281 this->assert_term_ref();
34282 term_ref_->id |= flecs::IsEntity;
34283 term_ref_->name = const_cast<char*>(name);
34284 return *this;
34285 }
34286
34288 Base& var(const char *var_name) {
34289 this->assert_term_ref();
34290 term_ref_->id |= flecs::IsVariable;
34291 term_ref_->name = const_cast<char*>(var_name);
34292 return *this;
34293 }
34294
34296 Base& flags(flecs::flags64_t flags) {
34297 this->assert_term_ref();
34298 term_ref_->id = flags;
34299 return *this;
34300 }
34301
34303 ecs_term_ref_t *term_ref_;
34304
34305protected:
34306 virtual flecs::world_t* world_v() = 0;
34307
34308 void assert_term_ref() {
34309 ecs_assert(term_ref_ != NULL, ECS_INVALID_PARAMETER,
34310 "no active term (call .with() first)");
34311 }
34312
34313private:
34314 operator Base&() {
34315 return *static_cast<Base*>(this);
34316 }
34317};

34811// Macros for template types so we don't go cross-eyed.
34812#define FLECS_TBUILDER template<typename ... Components> class
34813#define FLECS_IBUILDER template<typename IBase, typename ... Components> class
34814
34815template<FLECS_TBUILDER T, typename TDesc, typename Base, FLECS_IBUILDER IBuilder, typename ... Components>
34816struct builder : IBuilder<Base, Components ...>
34817{
34818 using IBase = IBuilder<Base, Components ...>;
34819
34820public:
34821 builder(flecs::world_t *world)
34822 : IBase(&desc_)
34823 , desc_{}
34824 , world_(world) { }
34825
34826 builder(const builder& f)
34827 : IBase(&desc_, f.term_index_)
34828 {
34829 world_ = f.world_;
34830 desc_ = f.desc_;
34831 }
34832
34833 builder(builder&& f) noexcept
34834 : builder<T, TDesc, Base, IBuilder, Components...>(f) { }
34835
34836 operator TDesc*() {
34837 return &desc_;
34838 }
34839
34840 operator const TDesc*() const {
34841 return &desc_;
34842 }
34843
34844 T<Components ...> build() const {
34845 return T<Components...>(world_, *static_cast<const Base*>(this));
34846 }
34847
34848protected:
34849 flecs::world_t* world_v() override { return world_; }
34850 TDesc desc_;
34851 flecs::world_t *world_;
34852};
34853
34854#undef FLECS_TBUILDER
34855#undef FLECS_IBUILDER
34856
34857} // namespace _
34858} // namespace flecs

35100 ECS_INVALID_OPERATION,

35105 ECS_INVALID_PARAMETER, "maximum number of terms exceeded");
35106

35108

35111 error:

35119 template <typename T>
35120 Base& term_at() {
35121 flecs::id_t term_id = _::type<T>::id(this->world_v());
35122 for (int i = 0; i < term_index_; i ++) {
35123 ecs_term_t cur_term = desc_->terms[i];
35124 ecs_id_t cur_term_id = cur_term.id;
35125 ecs_id_t cur_term_pair = ecs_pair(cur_term.first.id, cur_term.second.id);
35126
35127 if ((term_id == cur_term_id || (cur_term_id != 0 && term_id == ecs_get_typeid(this->world_v(), cur_term_id))) ||
35128 (term_id == cur_term_pair || (cur_term_pair != 0 && term_id == ecs_get_typeid(this->world_v(), cur_term_pair)))) {
35129 return term_at(i);
35130 }
35131 }
35132
35133 ecs_err("term not found");
35134 return *this;
35135 }
35136
35138 Base& term_at(int32_t term_index) {
35139 ecs_assert(term_index >= 0, ECS_INVALID_PARAMETER, NULL);
35140 int32_t prev_index = term_index_;
35141 term_index_ = term_index;
35142 this->term();
35143 term_index_ = prev_index;
35144 ecs_assert(ecs_term_is_initialized(this->term_),
35145 ECS_INVALID_PARAMETER, NULL);
35146 return *this;
35147 }
35148
35151 template <typename T>
35152 Base& term_at(int32_t term_index) {
35153 this->term_at(term_index);
35154#if !defined(FLECS_NDEBUG) || defined(FLECS_KEEP_ASSERT)
35155 flecs::id_t term_id = _::type<T>::id(this->world_v());
35156 ecs_term_t cur_term = *this->term_;
35157 ecs_id_t cur_term_id = cur_term.id;
35158 ecs_id_t cur_term_pair = ecs_pair(cur_term.first.id, cur_term.second.id);
35159
35160 ecs_assert((term_id == cur_term_id || (cur_term_id != 0 && term_id == ecs_get_typeid(this->world_v(), cur_term_id))) ||
35161 (term_id == cur_term_pair || (cur_term_pair != 0 && term_id == ecs_get_typeid(this->world_v(), cur_term_pair))),
35162 ECS_INVALID_PARAMETER, "term type mismatch");
35163#endif
35164 return *this;
35165 }
35166
35185 template <typename T>
35186 Base& order_by(int(*compare)(flecs::entity_t, const T*, flecs::entity_t, const T*)) {
35187 ecs_order_by_action_t cmp = reinterpret_cast<ecs_order_by_action_t>(compare);
35188 return this->order_by(_::type<T>::id(this->world_v()), cmp);
35189 }

35197 Base& order_by(flecs::entity_t component, int(*compare)(flecs::entity_t, const void*, flecs::entity_t, const void*)) {
35198 desc_->order_by_callback = reinterpret_cast<ecs_order_by_action_t>(compare);
35199 desc_->order_by = component;

35201 }

35223 return this->group_by(_::type<T>::id(this->world_v()), action);

35232 Base& group_by(flecs::entity_t component, uint64_t(*group_by_action)(flecs::world_t*, flecs::table_t *table, flecs::id_t id, void* ctx)) {
35233 desc_->group_by_callback = reinterpret_cast<ecs_group_by_action_t>(group_by_action);
35234 desc_->group_by = component;

35236 }

35243 template <typename T>
35244 Base& group_by() {
35245 return this->group_by(_::type<T>::id(this->world_v()), nullptr);
35246 }
35247
35253 Base& group_by(flecs::entity_t component) {

35262 Base& group_by_ctx(void *ctx, ecs_ctx_free_t ctx_free = nullptr) {

35282 int32_t term_index_;
35283 int32_t expr_count_;

35285private:

35288 }

35344struct query_base {
35346 query_base() { }
35347
35349 query_base(query_t *q)
35350 : query_(q) {
35351 flecs_poly_claim(q);
35352 }
35353
35355 query_base(const query_t *q)
35356 : query_(ECS_CONST_CAST(query_t*, q)) {
35357 flecs_poly_claim(q);
35358 }
35359
35361 query_base(world_t *world, const ecs_query_desc_t *desc) {
35362 if (desc->entity && desc->terms[0].id == 0) {
35363 const flecs::Poly *query_poly = ecs_get_pair(
35364 world, desc->entity, EcsPoly, EcsQuery);
35365 if (query_poly) {
35366 query_ = static_cast<flecs::query_t*>(query_poly->poly);
35367 flecs_poly_claim(query_);
35368 return;
35369 }
35370 }
35371
35372 query_ = ecs_query_init(world, desc);
35373 }
35374
35376 query_base(const query_base& obj) {
35377 this->query_ = obj.query_;
35378 if (this->query_)
35379 {
35380 flecs_poly_claim(this->query_);
35381 }
35382 }
35383
35385 query_base& operator=(const query_base& obj) {
35386 this->~query_base();
35387 this->query_ = obj.query_;
35388 if (this->query_)
35389 {
35390 flecs_poly_claim(this->query_);
35391 }
35392 return *this;
35393 }
35394
35396 query_base(query_base&& obj) noexcept {
35397 this->query_ = obj.query_;
35398 obj.query_ = nullptr;
35399 }
35400
35402 query_base& operator=(query_base&& obj) noexcept {
35403 this->query_ = obj.query_;
35404 obj.query_ = nullptr;
35405 return *this;
35406 }

35666// world::each
35667namespace _ {
35668
35669// Each with entity parameter
35670template<typename Func, typename ... Args>
35671struct query_delegate_w_ent;
35672
35673template<typename Func, typename E>
35674struct query_delegate_w_ent<Func, arg_list<E> >
35675{
35676 query_delegate_w_ent(const flecs::world& world, Func&& func) {
35677 ecs_entities_t entities = ecs_get_entities(ecs_get_world(world));
35678
35679 for (int32_t i = 0; i < entities.alive_count; i ++) {
35680 func(flecs::entity(world, entities.ids[i]));
35681 }
35682 }
35683};
35684
35685template<typename Func, typename E, typename ... Args>
35686struct query_delegate_w_ent<Func, arg_list<E, Args ...> >
35687{
35688 query_delegate_w_ent(const flecs::world& world, Func&& func) {
35689 auto f = world.query<Args ...>();
35690 f.each(FLECS_MOV(func));
35691 }
35692};
35693
35694// Each without entity parameter
35695template<typename Func, typename ... Args>
35696struct query_delegate_no_ent;
35697
35698template<typename Func, typename ... Args>
35699struct query_delegate_no_ent<Func, arg_list<Args ...> >
35700{
35701 query_delegate_no_ent(const flecs::world& world, Func&& func) {
35702 auto f = world.query<Args ...>();
35703 f.each(FLECS_MOV(func));
35704 }
35705};
35706
35707// Switch between function with and without entity parameter
35708template<typename Func, typename T = int>
35709struct query_delegate;
35710
35711template <typename Func>
35712struct query_delegate<Func, if_t<is_same<first_arg_t<Func>, flecs::entity>::value> > {
35713 query_delegate(const flecs::world& world, Func&& func) {
35714 query_delegate_w_ent<Func, arg_list_t<Func>>(world, FLECS_MOV(func));
35715 }
35716};
35717
35718template <typename Func>
35719struct query_delegate<Func, if_not_t<is_same<first_arg_t<Func>, flecs::entity>::value> > {
35720 query_delegate(const flecs::world& world, Func&& func) {
35721 query_delegate_no_ent<Func, arg_list_t<Func>>(world, FLECS_MOV(func));
35722 }
35723};
35724
35725}
35726
35727template <typename Func>
35728inline void world::each(Func&& func) const {
35729 _::query_delegate<Func> f_delegate(*this, FLECS_MOV(func));
35730}
35731
35732template <typename T, typename Func>
35733inline void world::each(Func&& func) const {
35734 ecs_iter_t it = ecs_each_id(world_, _::type<T>::id(world_));
35735
35736 while (ecs_each_next(&it)) {
35737 _::each_delegate<Func, T>(func).invoke(&it);
35738 }
35739}
35740
35741template <typename Func>
35742inline void world::each(flecs::id_t each_id, Func&& func) const {
35743 ecs_iter_t it = ecs_each_id(world_, each_id);
35744
35745 while (ecs_each_next(&it)) {
35746 _::each_delegate<Func>(func).invoke(&it);
35747 }
35748}

35752 return flecs::query<>(query_);

35766// Macros for template types so we don't go cross-eyed.
35767#define FLECS_IBUILDER template<typename IBase, typename ... Components> class
35768
35769template<typename T, typename TDesc, typename Base, FLECS_IBUILDER IBuilder, typename ... Components>
35770struct node_builder : IBuilder<Base, Components ...>
35771{
35772 using IBase = IBuilder<Base, Components ...>;
35773
35774public:
35775 explicit node_builder(flecs::world_t* world, const char *name = nullptr)
35776 : IBase(&desc_)
35777 , desc_{}
35778 , world_(world)
35779 {
35780 ecs_entity_desc_t entity_desc = {};
35781 entity_desc.name = name;
35782 entity_desc.sep = "::";
35783 entity_desc.root_sep = "::";
35784 desc_.entity = ecs_entity_init(world_, &entity_desc);
35785 }
35786
35787 template <typename Func>
35788 T run(Func&& func) {
35789 using Delegate = typename _::run_delegate<
35790 typename std::decay<Func>::type>;
35791
35792 auto ctx = FLECS_NEW(Delegate)(FLECS_FWD(func));
35793 desc_.run = Delegate::run;
35794 desc_.run_ctx = ctx;
35795 desc_.run_ctx_free = _::free_obj<Delegate>;
35796 return T(world_, &desc_);
35797 }
35798
35799 template <typename Func, typename EachFunc>
35800 T run(Func&& func, EachFunc&& each_func) {
35801 using Delegate = typename _::run_delegate<
35802 typename std::decay<Func>::type>;
35803
35804 auto ctx = FLECS_NEW(Delegate)(FLECS_FWD(func));
35805 desc_.run = Delegate::run;
35806 desc_.run_ctx = ctx;
35807 desc_.run_ctx_free = _::free_obj<Delegate>;
35808 return each(FLECS_FWD(each_func));
35809 }
35810
35811 template <typename Func>
35812 T each(Func&& func) {
35813 using Delegate = typename _::each_delegate<
35814 typename std::decay<Func>::type, Components...>;
35815 auto ctx = FLECS_NEW(Delegate)(FLECS_FWD(func));
35816 desc_.callback = Delegate::run;
35817 desc_.callback_ctx = ctx;
35818 desc_.callback_ctx_free = _::free_obj<Delegate>;
35819 return T(world_, &desc_);
35820 }
35821
35822 template <typename Func>
35823 T run_each(Func&& func) {
35824 using Delegate = typename _::each_delegate<
35825 typename std::decay<Func>::type, Components...>;
35826 auto ctx = FLECS_NEW(Delegate)(FLECS_FWD(func));
35827 desc_.run = Delegate::run_each;
35828 desc_.run_ctx = ctx;
35829 desc_.run_ctx_free = _::free_obj<Delegate>;
35830 return T(world_, &desc_);
35831 }
35832
35833protected:
35834 flecs::world_t* world_v() override { return world_; }
35835 TDesc desc_;
35836 flecs::world_t *world_;
35837};
35838
35839#undef FLECS_IBUILDER

36015private:
36016 template <typename ... CallbackComponents, typename Func>
36017 observer& each_callback(_::arg_list<CallbackComponents...>, Func&& func) {
36018 using Delegate = typename _::each_delegate<
36019 typename std::decay<Func>::type, CallbackComponents...>;
36020 auto ctx = FLECS_NEW(Delegate)(FLECS_FWD(func));
36021 ecs_observer_desc_t desc = {};
36022 desc.callback = Delegate::run;
36023 desc.callback_ctx = ctx;
36024 desc.callback_ctx_free = _::free_obj<Delegate>;
36025 ecs_observer_update(world_, id_, &desc);
36026 return *this;
36027 }
36028
36029 template <typename ... CallbackComponents, typename Func>
36030 observer& run_each_callback(_::arg_list<CallbackComponents...>, Func&& func) {
36031 using Delegate = typename _::each_delegate<
36032 typename std::decay<Func>::type, CallbackComponents...>;
36033 auto ctx = FLECS_NEW(Delegate)(FLECS_FWD(func));
36034 ecs_observer_desc_t desc = {};
36035 desc.run = Delegate::run_each;
36036 desc.run_ctx = ctx;
36037 desc.run_ctx_free = _::free_obj<Delegate>;
36038 ecs_observer_update(world_, id_, &desc);
36039 return *this;
36040 }
36041};

36180
36181template <typename T>
36182ecs_entity_t do_import(world& world, const char *symbol) {
36183 ecs_trace("#[magenta]import#[reset] %s", _::type_name<T>());
36184 ecs_log_push();
36185
36186 ecs_entity_t scope = ecs_set_scope(world, 0);
36187
36188 // Initialize module component type and don't allow it to be registered as a
36189 // tag, as this would prevent calling emplace().
36190 auto c_ = component<T>(world, nullptr, false);
36191
36192 // Make module component sparse so that it'll never move in memory. This
36193 // guarantees that a module destructor can be reliably used to clean up
36194 // module resources.
36195 c_.add(flecs::Sparse);
36196
36197 c_.add(flecs::Singleton);
36198
36199 ecs_set_scope(world, c_);
36200 world.emplace<T>(world);
36201 ecs_set_scope(world, scope);
36202
36203 ecs_add_id(world, c_, EcsModule);
36204
36205 // It should now be possible to look up the module.
36206 ecs_entity_t m = ecs_lookup_symbol(world, symbol, false, false);
36207 ecs_assert(m != 0, ECS_MODULE_UNDEFINED, "%s", symbol);
36208 ecs_assert(m == c_, ECS_INTERNAL_ERROR, NULL);
36209
36210 ecs_log_pop();
36211
36212 return m;
36213}
36214
36215template <typename T>
36216flecs::entity import(world& world) {
36217 char *symbol = ecs_cpp_get_symbol_name(NULL, type_name<T>(), 0);
36218
36219 ecs_entity_t m = ecs_lookup_symbol(world, symbol, true, false);
36220
36221 if (!_::type<T>::registered(world)) {
36222 // Module is registered with world, initialize static data.
36223 if (m) {
36224 _::type<T>::init_builtin(world, m, false);
36225
36226 // Module is not yet registered, register it now.
36227 } else {
36228 m = _::do_import<T>(world, symbol);
36229 }
36230
36231 // Module has been registered, but could have been for another world.
36232 // Import if module hasn't been registered for this world.
36233 } else if (!m) {
36234 m = _::do_import<T>(world, symbol);
36235 }
36236
36237 ecs_os_free(symbol);
36238 return flecs::entity(world, m);
36239}
36240
36241}
36242
36251template <typename Module>
36252inline flecs::entity world::module(const char *name) const {
36253 flecs::entity result = this->entity(
36254 _::type<Module>::register_id(world_, nullptr, false));
36255
36256 if (name) {
36257 flecs::entity prev_parent = result.parent();
36258 ecs_add_path_w_sep(world_, result, 0, name, "::", "::");
36259 flecs::entity parent = result.parent();
36260 if (prev_parent != parent) {
36261 // Module was reparented, clean up old parent(s).
36262 flecs::entity cur = prev_parent, next;
36263 while (cur) {
36264 next = cur.parent();
36265 cur.destruct();
36266 this->set_version(cur);
36267 cur = next;
36268 }
36269 }
36270 }
36271
36272 return result;
36273}
36274
36275template <typename Module>
36276inline flecs::entity world::import() {
36277 return flecs::_::import<Module>(*this);
36278}

36300template<typename Base, typename ... Components>
36301struct system_builder_i : query_builder_i<Base, Components ...> {
36302private:
36303 using BaseClass = query_builder_i<Base, Components ...>;
36304
36305public:
36306 system_builder_i(ecs_system_desc_t *desc)
36307 : BaseClass(&desc->query)
36308 , desc_(desc) { }
36309
36314 Base& kind(entity_t phase) {
36315 flecs::entity_t cur_phase = ecs_get_target(
36316 world_v(), desc_->entity, EcsDependsOn, 0);
36317 if (cur_phase) {
36318 ecs_remove_id(world_v(), desc_->entity, ecs_dependson(cur_phase));
36319 ecs_remove_id(world_v(), desc_->entity, cur_phase);
36320 }
36321 if (phase) {
36322 ecs_add_id(world_v(), desc_->entity, ecs_dependson(phase));
36323 ecs_add_id(world_v(), desc_->entity, phase);
36324 }
36325 return *this;
36326 }
36327
36332 template <typename E, if_t<is_enum<E>::value> = 0>
36333 Base& kind(E phase)
36334 {
36335 const auto& et = enum_type<E>(this->world_v());
36336 flecs::entity_t target = et.entity(phase);
36337 return this->kind(target);
36338 }
36339
36344 template <typename Phase>
36345 Base& kind() {
36346 return this->kind(_::type<Phase>::id(world_v()));
36347 }
36348
36353 Base& multi_threaded(bool value = true) {
36354 desc_->multi_threaded = value;
36355 return *this;
36356 }
36357
36362 Base& immediate(bool value = true) {
36363 desc_->immediate = value;
36364 return *this;
36365 }
36366
36374 Base& interval(ecs_ftime_t interval) {
36375 desc_->interval = interval;
36376 return *this;
36377 }
36378
36387 Base& rate(const entity_t tick_source, int32_t rate) {
36388 desc_->rate = rate;
36389 desc_->tick_source = tick_source;
36390 return *this;
36391 }
36392
36400 Base& rate(int32_t rate) {
36401 desc_->rate = rate;
36402 return *this;
36403 }
36404
36410 template<typename T>
36411 Base& tick_source() {
36412 desc_->tick_source = _::type<T>::id(world_v());
36413 return *this;
36414 }
36415
36421 Base& tick_source(flecs::entity_t tick_source) {
36422 desc_->tick_source = tick_source;
36423 return *this;
36424 }
36425
36427 Base& ctx(void *ptr) {
36428 desc_->ctx = ptr;
36429 return *this;
36430 }
36431
36433 Base& run(ecs_iter_action_t action) {
36434 desc_->run = action;
36435 return *this;
36436 }
36437
36438protected:
36439 virtual flecs::world_t* world_v() override = 0;
36440
36441private:
36442 operator Base&() {
36443 return *static_cast<Base*>(this);
36444 }

36446 ecs_system_desc_t *desc_;

36498 system_runner_fluent(
36499 world_t *world,
36500 entity_t id,
36501 int32_t stage_current,
36502 int32_t stage_count,

36525 system_runner_fluent& stage(flecs::world& stage) {
36526 stage_ = stage.c_ptr();

36531 ~system_runner_fluent() {
36532 if (stage_count_) {
36533 ecs_run_worker(
36534 stage_, id_, stage_current_, stage_count_, delta_time_,

36537 ecs_run(stage_, id_, delta_time_, param_);

36545 void *param_;

36549 int32_t stage_count_;

36755template <typename ... Components>
36756template <typename Func>
36757inline system system_builder<Components...>::each(Func&& func) {
36758 if constexpr (sizeof...(Components) == 0) {
36759 using CallbackComponents =
36760 typename _::each_callback_args<arg_list_t<Func>>::type;
36761 return this->each_callback(CallbackComponents{}, FLECS_FWD(func));
36762 } else {
36763 // Faster version of each() that iterates the query on the C++ side.
36764 return this->run_each(FLECS_FWD(func));
36765 }
36766}
36767
36768template <typename ... Components>
36769template <typename ... CallbackComponents, typename Func>
36770inline system system_builder<Components...>::each_callback(
36771 _::arg_list<CallbackComponents...>,
36772 Func&& func)
36773{
36774 this->template prepend_each_callback_signature<CallbackComponents...>();
36775
36776 using Delegate = typename _::each_delegate<
36777 typename std::decay<Func>::type, CallbackComponents...>;
36778
36779 auto ctx = FLECS_NEW(Delegate)(FLECS_FWD(func));
36780 this->desc_.run = Delegate::run_each;
36781 this->desc_.run_ctx = ctx;
36782 this->desc_.run_ctx_free = _::free_obj<Delegate>;
36783 return system(this->world_, &this->desc_);
36784}
36785
36786template <typename ... Components>
36787template <typename ... CallbackComponents>
36788inline void system_builder<Components...>::prepend_each_callback_signature() {
36789 if constexpr (sizeof...(Components) == 0 && sizeof...(CallbackComponents) != 0) {
36790 constexpr int32_t callback_term_count =
36791 static_cast<int32_t>(sizeof...(CallbackComponents));
36792
36793 ecs_assert(this->term_index_ + callback_term_count <= FLECS_TERM_COUNT_MAX,
36794 ECS_INVALID_PARAMETER, "maximum number of terms exceeded");
36795
36796 const int32_t existing_term_count = this->term_index_;
36797 this->set_term(nullptr);
36798
36799 for (int32_t i = existing_term_count - 1; i >= 0; i --) {
36800 this->desc_.query.terms[i + callback_term_count] =
36801 this->desc_.query.terms[i];
36802 }
36803
36804 for (int32_t i = 0; i < callback_term_count; i ++) {
36805 this->desc_.query.terms[i] = ecs_term_t{};
36806 }
36807
36808 this->term_index_ = 0;
36809 _::sig<CallbackComponents...>(this->world_).populate(this);
36810 this->term_index_ = existing_term_count + callback_term_count;
36811 }
36812}

37257#pragma once
37258
37259FLECS_ENUM_LAST(flecs::meta::type_kind_t, flecs::meta::TypeKindLast)
37260FLECS_ENUM_LAST(flecs::meta::primitive_kind_t, flecs::meta::PrimitiveKindLast)
37261
37262namespace flecs {
37263namespace meta {
37264namespace _ {
37265
37267template <typename EntityType>
37268inline flecs::opaque<EntityType> flecs_entity_support(flecs::world&) {
37269 return flecs::opaque<EntityType>()
37270 .as_type(flecs::Entity)
37271 .serialize([](const flecs::serializer *ser, const EntityType *data) {
37272 flecs::entity_t id = data->id();
37273 return ser->value(flecs::Entity, &id);
37274 })
37275 .assign_entity(
37276 [](EntityType *dst, flecs::world_t *world, flecs::entity_t e) {
37277 *dst = EntityType(world, e);
37278 });
37279}
37280
37281inline void init(flecs::world& world) {
37282 world.component<bool_t>("flecs::meta::bool");
37283 world.component<char_t>("flecs::meta::char");
37284 world.component<u8_t>("flecs::meta::u8");
37285 world.component<u16_t>("flecs::meta::u16");
37286 world.component<u32_t>("flecs::meta::u32");
37287 world.component<u64_t>("flecs::meta::u64");
37288 world.component<i8_t>("flecs::meta::i8");
37289 world.component<i16_t>("flecs::meta::i16");
37290 world.component<i32_t>("flecs::meta::i32");
37291 world.component<i64_t>("flecs::meta::i64");
37292 world.component<f32_t>("flecs::meta::f32");
37293 world.component<f64_t>("flecs::meta::f64");
37294
37295 world.component<type_kind_t>("flecs::meta::type_kind");
37296 world.component<primitive_kind_t>("flecs::meta::primitive_kind");
37297 world.component<member_t>("flecs::meta::member_t");
37298 world.component<enum_constant_t>("flecs::meta::enum_constant");
37299 world.component<bitmask_constant_t>("flecs::meta::bitmask_constant");
37300
37301 world.component<Type>("flecs::meta::type");
37302 world.component<TypeSerializer>("flecs::meta::TypeSerializer");
37303 world.component<Primitive>("flecs::meta::primitive");
37304 world.component<Enum>("flecs::meta::enum");
37305 world.component<Bitmask>("flecs::meta::bitmask");
37306 world.component<Member>("flecs::meta::member");
37307 world.component<MemberRanges>("flecs::meta::member_ranges");
37308 world.component<Struct>("flecs::meta::struct");
37309 world.component<Array>("flecs::meta::array");
37310 world.component<Vector>("flecs::meta::vector");
37311
37312 world.component<Unit>("flecs::meta::unit");
37313
37314 // To support member<uintptr_t> and member<intptr_t>, register components
37315 // (that do not have conflicting symbols with built-in ones) for
37316 // platform-specific types.
37317
37318 if (!flecs::is_same<i32_t, iptr_t>() && !flecs::is_same<i64_t, iptr_t>()) {
37319 flecs::_::type<iptr_t>::init_builtin(world, flecs::Iptr, true);
37320 // Remove symbol to prevent validation errors, as it doesn't match
37321 // the typename.
37322 ecs_remove_pair(world, flecs::Iptr, ecs_id(EcsIdentifier), EcsSymbol);
37323 }
37324
37325 if (!flecs::is_same<u32_t, uptr_t>() && !flecs::is_same<u64_t, uptr_t>()) {
37326 flecs::_::type<uptr_t>::init_builtin(world, flecs::Uptr, true);
37327 // Remove symbol to prevent validation errors, as it doesn't match
37328 // the typename.
37329 ecs_remove_pair(world, flecs::Uptr, ecs_id(EcsIdentifier), EcsSymbol);
37330 }
37331
37332 // Register opaque type support for C++ entity wrappers.
37333 world.entity("::flecs::cpp").add(flecs::Module).scope([&]{
37334 world.component<flecs::entity_view>()
37335 .opaque(flecs_entity_support<flecs::entity_view>);
37336 world.component<flecs::entity>()
37337 .opaque(flecs_entity_support<flecs::entity>);
37338 });
37339}
37340
37341} // namespace _
37342
37343} // namespace meta

37682inline metric_builder& metric_builder::member(const char *name) {
37683 flecs::entity m;
37684 if (desc_.id) {
37685 flecs::entity_t type = ecs_get_typeid(world_, desc_.id);
37686 m = flecs::entity(world_, type).lookup(name);
37687 } else {
37688 m = flecs::world(world_).lookup(name);
37689 }
37690 if (!m) {
37691 flecs::log::err("member '%s' not found", name);
37692 }
37693 return member(m);
37694}

37696template <typename T>
37697inline metric_builder& metric_builder::member(const char *name) {
37698 flecs::entity e (world_, _::type<T>::id(world_));
37699 flecs::entity_t m = e.lookup(name);
37700 if (!m) {
37701 flecs::log::err("member '%s' not found in type '%s'",
37702 name, e.path().c_str());
37703 return *this;
37704 }
37705 return member(m);
37706}

37720inline metric_builder::operator flecs::entity() {

37722 created_ = true;
37723 flecs::entity result(world_, ecs_metric_init(world_, &desc_));
37724 desc_.entity = result;

37736
37737template <typename Kind>
37738inline untyped_component& untyped_component::metric(
37739 flecs::entity_t parent,
37740 const char *brief,
37741 const char *metric_name)
37742{
37743 flecs::world w(world_);
37744 flecs::entity e(world_, id_);
37745
37746 const flecs::member_t *m = ecs_cpp_last_member(w, e);
37747 if (!m) {
37748 return *this;
37749 }
37750
37751 flecs::entity me = w.entity(m->member);
37752 flecs::entity metric_entity = me;
37753 if (parent) {
37754 const char *component_name = e.name();
37755 if (!metric_name) {
37756 if (ecs_os_strcmp(m->name, "value") || !component_name) {
37757 metric_entity = w.scope(parent).entity(m->name);
37758 } else {
37759 // If name of member is "value", use name of type.
37760 char *snake_name = flecs_to_snake_case(component_name);
37761 metric_entity = w.scope(parent).entity(snake_name);
37762 ecs_os_free(snake_name);
37763 }
37764 } else {
37765 metric_entity = w.scope(parent).entity(metric_name);
37766 }
37767 }
37768
37769 w.metric(metric_entity).member(me).kind<Kind>().brief(brief);
37770
37771 return *this;
37772}

37786
37791template<typename Base, typename ... Components>
37792struct alert_builder_i : query_builder_i<Base, Components ...> {
37793private:
37794 using BaseClass = query_builder_i<Base, Components ...>;
37795
37796public:
37797 alert_builder_i()
37798 : BaseClass(nullptr)
37799 , desc_(nullptr) { }
37800
37801 alert_builder_i(ecs_alert_desc_t *desc, int32_t term_index = 0)
37802 : BaseClass(&desc->query, term_index)
37803 , desc_(desc) { }
37804
37809 Base& message(const char *message) {
37810 desc_->message = message;
37811 return *this;
37812 }
37813
37818 Base& brief(const char *brief) {
37819 desc_->brief = brief;
37820 return *this;
37821 }
37822
37827 Base& doc_name(const char *doc_name) {
37828 desc_->doc_name = doc_name;
37829 return *this;
37830 }
37831
37836 Base& severity(flecs::entity_t kind) {
37837 desc_->severity = kind;
37838 return *this;
37839 }
37840
37845 Base& retain_period(ecs_ftime_t period) {
37846 desc_->retain_period = period;
37847 return *this;
37848 }
37849
37855 template <typename Severity>
37856 Base& severity() {
37857 return severity(_::type<Severity>::id(world_v()));
37858 }
37859
37866 Base& severity_filter(flecs::entity_t kind, flecs::id_t with, const char *var = nullptr) {
37867 ecs_assert(severity_filter_count < ECS_ALERT_MAX_SEVERITY_FILTERS,
37868 ECS_INVALID_PARAMETER, "Maximum number of severity filters reached");
37869
37870 ecs_alert_severity_filter_t *filter =
37871 &desc_->severity_filters[severity_filter_count ++];
37872
37873 filter->severity = kind;
37874 filter->with = with;
37875 filter->var = var;
37876 return *this;
37877 }
37878
37885 template <typename Severity>
37886 Base& severity_filter(flecs::id_t with, const char *var = nullptr) {
37887 return severity_filter(_::type<Severity>::id(world_v()), with, var);
37888 }
37889
37896 template <typename Severity, typename T, if_not_t< is_enum<T>::value > = 0>
37897 Base& severity_filter(const char *var = nullptr) {
37898 return severity_filter(_::type<Severity>::id(world_v()),
37899 _::type<T>::id(world_v()), var);
37900 }
37901
37909 template <typename Severity, typename T, if_t< is_enum<T>::value > = 0 >
37910 Base& severity_filter(T with, const char *var = nullptr) {
37911 flecs::world w(world_v());
37912 flecs::entity constant = w.to_entity<T>(with);
37913 return severity_filter(_::type<Severity>::id(world_v()),
37914 w.pair<T>(constant), var);
37915 }
37916
37918 Base& member(flecs::entity_t m) {
37919 desc_->member = m;
37920 return *this;
37921 }
37922
37925 Base& id(flecs::id_t id) {
37926 desc_->id = id;
37927 return *this;
37928 }
37929
37931 template <typename T>
37932 Base& member(const char *m, const char *v = nullptr) {
37933 flecs::entity_t id = _::type<T>::id(world_v());
37934 flecs::entity_t mid = ecs_lookup_path_w_sep(
37935 world_v(), id, m, "::", "::", false);
37936 ecs_assert(mid != 0, ECS_INVALID_PARAMETER, NULL);
37937 desc_->var = v;
37938 return this->member(mid);
37939 }
37940
37942 Base& var(const char *v) {
37943 desc_->var = v;
37944 return *this;
37945 }
37946
37947protected:
37948 virtual flecs::world_t* world_v() = 0;
37949
37950private:
37951 operator Base&() {
37952 return *static_cast<Base*>(this);
37953 }
37954
37955 ecs_alert_desc_t *desc_;
37956 int32_t severity_filter_count = 0;
37957};
37958
37959}

38046 inline ecs_value_t get_const_var(const flecs::world_t *world, const char *name) {
38047 flecs::entity_t v = ecs_lookup_path_w_sep(
38048 world, 0, name, "::", "::", false);
38049 if (!v) {
38050 ecs_warn("unresolved const variable '%s', returning default", name);
38051 return {};
38052 }
38053
38054 ecs_value_t value = ecs_const_var_get(world, v);
38055 if (value.ptr == nullptr) {
38056 ecs_warn("entity '%s' is not a const variable, returning default",
38057 name);
38058 return {};
38059 }
38060
38061 return value;
38062 }
38063
38064 template <typename T>
38065 inline T get_const_value(
38066 flecs::world_t *world, const char *name, ecs_value_t value, ecs_entity_t type, const T& default_value)
38067 {
38068 char *requested_type = ecs_get_path(world, type);
38069 char *var_type = ecs_get_path(world, value.type);
38070 ecs_warn("cannot cast const variable '%s' from type '%s' to '%s', "
38071 "returning default", name, var_type, requested_type);
38072 ecs_os_free(requested_type);
38073 ecs_os_free(var_type);
38074 return default_value;
38075 }

38081 (void)name; (void)type; (void)default_value;
38082 ecs_meta_cursor_t cur = ecs_meta_cursor(world, value.type, value.ptr);
38083 return ecs_meta_get_char(&cur);
38084 }

38177template <typename T>
38178inline T world::get_const_var(
38179 const char *name,
38180 const T& default_value) const
38181{
38182 ecs_value_t value = flecs::_::get_const_var(world_, name);
38183 if (!value.ptr) {
38184 return default_value;
38185 }
38186
38187 flecs::id_t type = flecs::_::type<T>::id(world_);
38188 if (type == value.type) {
38189 return *(static_cast<T*>(value.ptr));
38190 }
38191
38192 return flecs::_::get_const_value<T>(
38193 world_, name, value, type, default_value);
38194}
38195
38196template <typename T>
38197void world::get_const_var(
38198 const char *name,
38199 T& out,
38200 const T& default_value) const
38201{
38202 ecs_value_t value = flecs::_::get_const_var(world_, name);
38203 if (!value.ptr) {
38204 out = default_value;
38205 return;
38206 }
38207
38208 flecs::id_t type = flecs::_::type<T>::id(world_);
38209 if (type == value.type) {
38210 out = *(static_cast<T*>(value.ptr));
38211 return;
38212 }
38213
38214 out = flecs::_::get_const_value<T>(
38215 world_, name, value, type, default_value);
38216}

38242template <typename T>
38243inline field<T>::field(iter &iter, int32_t index) {
38244 *this = iter.field<T>(index);

38246
38252template <typename T>
38253T& field<T>::operator[](size_t index) const {
38254 ecs_assert(data_ != nullptr, ECS_INVALID_OPERATION,
38255 "invalid nullptr dereference of component type %s",
38256 _::type_name<T>());
38257 ecs_assert(index < count_, ECS_COLUMN_INDEX_OUT_OF_RANGE,
38258 "index %d out of range for array of component type %s",
38259 index, _::type_name<T>());
38260 ecs_assert(!index || !is_shared_, ECS_INVALID_PARAMETER,
38261 "non-zero index invalid for shared field of component type %s",
38262 _::type_name<T>());
38263 return data_[index];
38264}
38265
38271template <typename T>
38272T& field<T>::operator*() const {
38273 ecs_assert(data_ != nullptr, ECS_INVALID_OPERATION,
38274 "invalid nullptr dereference of component type %s",
38275 _::type_name<T>());
38276 return *data_;
38277}
38278
38284template <typename T>
38285T* field<T>::operator->() const {
38286 ecs_assert(data_ != nullptr, ECS_INVALID_OPERATION,
38287 "invalid nullptr dereference of component type %s",
38288 _::type_name<T>());
38289 ecs_assert(data_ != nullptr, ECS_INVALID_OPERATION,
38290 "-> operator invalid for an array with >1 element of "
38291 "component type %s, use [row] instead",
38292 _::type_name<T>());
38293 return data_;
38294}
