38371template <typename T, typename A, if_t< is_const_v<T> >>
38372inline flecs::field<A> iter::field(int8_t index) const {
38373 ecs_assert(!(iter_->flags & EcsIterCppEach) ||
38374 ecs_field_src(iter_, index) != 0, ECS_INVALID_OPERATION,
38375 "cannot .field from .each, use .field_at<%s>(%d, row) instead",
38376 _::type_name<T>(), index);
38377 return get_field<A>(index);
38378}
38379
38381template <typename T, typename A, if_not_t< is_const_v<T> >>
38382inline flecs::field<A> iter::field(int8_t index) const {
38383 ecs_assert(!(iter_->flags & EcsIterCppEach) ||
38384 ecs_field_src(iter_, index) != 0, ECS_INVALID_OPERATION,
38385 "cannot .field from .each, use .field_at<%s>(%d, row) instead",
38386 _::type_name<T>(), index);
38387 ecs_assert(!ecs_field_is_readonly(iter_, index),
38388 ECS_ACCESS_VIOLATION, NULL);
38389 return get_field<A>(index);
38390}
38391
38393inline flecs::entity iter::get_var(int var_id) const {
38394 ecs_assert(var_id != -1, ECS_INVALID_PARAMETER, 0);
38395 return flecs::entity(iter_->world, ecs_iter_get_var(iter_, var_id));
38396}
38397
38401inline flecs::entity iter::get_var(const char *name) const {
38402 const flecs::query_t *q = iter_->query;
38403
38404 int var_id = ecs_query_find_var(q, name);
38405 ecs_assert(var_id != -1, ECS_INVALID_PARAMETER, "%s", name);
38406 return flecs::entity(iter_->world, ecs_iter_get_var(iter_, var_id));
38407}
38408
38410template <typename Func>
38411void iter::targets(int8_t index, const Func& func) {
38412 ecs_assert(iter_->table != nullptr, ECS_INVALID_OPERATION, NULL);
38413 ecs_assert(index < iter_->field_count, ECS_INVALID_PARAMETER, NULL);
38414 ecs_assert(ecs_field_is_set(iter_, index), ECS_INVALID_PARAMETER, NULL);
38415 const ecs_type_t *table_type = ecs_table_get_type(iter_->table);
38416 const ecs_table_record_t *tr = iter_->trs[index];
38417 int32_t i = tr->index, end = i + tr->count;
38418 for (; i < end; i ++) {
38419 ecs_id_t id = table_type->array[i];
38420 ecs_assert(ECS_IS_PAIR(id), ECS_INVALID_PARAMETER,
38421 "field does not match a pair");
38422 flecs::entity tgt(iter_->world,
38423 ecs_pair_second(iter_->real_world, id));
38424 func(tgt);
38425 }
38426}

38436inline void world::init_builtin_components() {
38437 this->component<Component>();
38438 this->component<Identifier>();
38439 this->component<Poly>();
38440 this->component<Parent>();
38441
38442 /* If meta is not defined and we're using enum reflection, make sure that
38443 * primitive types are registered. This ensures we can set components of
38444 * underlying_type_t<E> when registering constants. */
38445# if !defined(FLECS_META) && !defined(FLECS_CPP_NO_ENUM_REFLECTION)
38446 this->component<uint8_t>("flecs::meta::u8");
38447 this->component<uint16_t>("flecs::meta::u16");
38448 this->component<uint32_t>("flecs::meta::u32");
38449 this->component<uint64_t>("flecs::meta::u64");
38450 this->component<int8_t>("flecs::meta::i8");
38451 this->component<int16_t>("flecs::meta::i16");
38452 this->component<int32_t>("flecs::meta::i32");
38453 this->component<int64_t>("flecs::meta::i64");
38454# endif
38455
38456# ifdef FLECS_SYSTEM
38457 _::system_init(*this);
38458# endif
38459# ifdef FLECS_TIMER
38460 _::timer_init(*this);
38461# endif
38462# ifdef FLECS_DOC
38463 doc::_::init(*this);
38464# endif
38465# ifdef FLECS_REST
38466 rest::_::init(*this);
38467# endif
38468# ifdef FLECS_META
38469 meta::_::init(*this);
38470# endif
38471# ifdef FLECS_SCRIPT
38472 script::_::init(*this);
38473# endif
38474}

38477template <typename T>
38478inline flecs::entity world::use(const char *alias) const {
38479 entity_t e = _::type<T>::id(world_);
38480 const char *name = alias;
38481 if (!name) {
38482 // If no name is defined, use the entity name without the scope.
38483 name = ecs_get_name(world_, e);
38484 }
38485 ecs_set_alias(world_, e, name);
38486 return flecs::entity(world_, e);
38487}

38490inline flecs::entity world::use(const char *name, const char *alias) const {
38491 entity_t e = ecs_lookup_path_w_sep(world_, 0, name, "::", "::", true);

38493
38494 ecs_set_alias(world_, e, alias);
38495 return flecs::entity(world_, e);
38496}

38869template <typename E>
38870inline flecs::entity enum_data<E>::entity(underlying_type_t<E> value) const {
38871 int index = index_by_value(value);
38872 if (index >= 0) {
38873 int32_t constant_i = impl_.constants[index].index;
38874 flecs::entity_t entity = flecs_component_ids_get(world_, constant_i);
38875 return flecs::entity(world_, entity);
38876 }
38877#ifdef FLECS_META
38878 // Reflection data lookup failed. Try a value lookup among flecs::Constant relationships.
38879 flecs::world world = flecs::world(world_);
38880 return world.query_builder()
38881 .with(flecs::ChildOf, world.id<E>())
38882 .with(flecs::Constant, world.id<int32_t>())
38883 .build()
38884 .find([value](flecs::entity constant) {
38885 const int32_t& constant_value = constant.get_second<int32_t>(flecs::Constant);
38886 return value == static_cast<underlying_type_t<E>>(constant_value);
38887 });
38888#else
38889 return flecs::entity::null(world_);
38890#endif
38891}
38892
38894template <typename E>
38895inline flecs::entity enum_data<E>::entity(E value) const {
38896 return entity(static_cast<underlying_type_t<E>>(value));
38897}
